# Fisher Scientific UK

> > Fisher Scientific UK is a leading supplier of scientific research products, specializing in Invitrogen antibodies for life sciences research and industrial fluid handling solutions from CPC Colder Products Company.

The site offers a comprehensive catalog of laboratory products including recombinant monoclonal antibodies for Western blot and immunohistochemistry applications, aseptic connectors and sterile coupling systems for biopharmaceutical manufacturing, and specialized packaging solutions from Berlin Packaging. Products support research areas including Alzheimer's disease, neurodegenerative disorders, and cellular signaling pathways.

## Key Topics

- Invitrogen antibodies
- Recombinant monoclonal antibodies
- Western blot applications
- Primary antibodies
- Rabbit antibodies
- CPC Colder Products Company
- AseptiQuik sterile connectors
- Fluid handling systems
- Biopharmaceutical equipment
- Immunohistochemistry
- Alzheimer's disease research
- Amyloid precursor protein (APP)
- Berlin Packaging solutions
- Type 3 glass bottles
- Laboratory packaging
